status: pre-execution proposal; freeze final case identifiers and source hashes before live calls
authority: Product-specification advisory methodology, not product contract
researchQuestion: Does declaration size and separation of related facts change detection and repair under native Hapsland and Abide input boundaries?

environment.comparator: Unmodified released Abide 0.0.7 custom active same Noul rubric
environment.productCode: Pinned repaired configuration; no product or rule mutation during measured study

alternativeAllNineRules.nativeGoldSelection: One preselected defect per domain and one clean control in each domain at separated layout only OR three domain pairs across compact and separated; freeze exact selection before live
alternativeAllNineRules.warning: Cannot run all nine rules across all layouts with full native matrix under336; do not silently expand budget

selection: Independent source/design review ranks domain clarity, plausible production use, readability, and oracle strength BEFORE any live Jev result.
Pick at least two interface and two function domains, preferably differing rule families; preserve all rejected candidate IDs and editorial reasons in selection ledger.
Every frozen domain has all three layouts and a clean counterpart. No replacement of losing cases, no preferential repeat of wins.
Highlight readable examples independently of measured win/loss; report every frozen case and all unknown/timeout outcomes.
Prior small examples remain separate evidence, not pooled with new matched compact cases.
layoutContract: Compact contains genuine essential domain facts, not token-minimizing obfuscation. Large variants have identical semantic facts and support definitions to each other.

Large-adjacent and large-separated differ only in declaration-order arrangement of fields or statements wherever semantics permit. Added unrelated fields must serve the same realistic domain and retain documented independence.
Target 10–25 substantive declaration lines; avoid padding via empty lines or repeated comments. Report actual declaration lines, edit-to-related-evidence distance, and emitted input line count.
Nested variants add representation depth and must be labeled separately; do not conflate nesting effects with field-distance effects.
Function statement reorderings must preserve behavior: no moving side effects across order-sensitive operations. Prefer reordering pure declarations or layout of separate helpers.
Critical linked fields can be outside actual diff context in separated layout, but compiler-observable contracts and production context must still express the defect.
editEquivalence: Freeze identical minimal maintenance edit per matched layout, for example label to displayLabel, with no extra diagnosis or explicit instruction to repair the seeded defect.
The flaw is already present before the rename; explicitly call this touched-declaration inspection, not detection of newly introduced bugs.
Before live compare produced unified diffs: equal changed tokens, same changed-line count, same context setting, and no relation-bearing comments or type declarations accidentally added to the hunk.
Abide diff context width is established from its actual source and captured handler input, not assumed3or5. Record actual visible relevant facts and Hapsland included graph facts.
The native actor sees the same complete starting repository and task across arms. Delivery differences are native product behavior; do not hide files from the baseline actor.
preflight: Compile all before/after/support files under strict independent TypeScript and verify the maintenance patch applies uniquely.
Freeze case source, supporting source, rule, adapter, scorer and task hashes, CLI and model metadata, thresholds and request ceilings.
Run real Hapsland preparation to establish eligible/unchecked counts and omission diagnostics before live; classify unavailable context as unchecked rather than backend clear.
Offline handler capture verifies actual Abide input and Hapsland context projections for every layout with fake backend answers and zero Jev calls.
Keep exclusions empty; preserve unchanged runtime instruction format across all layouts.
independentScoring: Anonymous final source plus supporting source and domain contract only; do not expose candidate labels, backend decisions, hook receipts or session logs to scorer.
Compiler witnesses are assigned through previously declared variables, not only fresh object literals, so excess-property checking does not masquerade as a structural invariant.
Every valid witness includes all newly required independent fields; preserve optionality, value domain and data semantics of all added fields, not only the original target pair.

For correlated fields test both missing-half orientations and representative complete values. For domain limitations retain every documented permissible variant and reject at least two inadmissible values.
Property presence and semantic value-domain preservation are checked even where structural assignment would accept extra fields; deletion of facts is not repair.
Function runtime probes use explicit fake dependencies, multiple inputs and boundary cases; assert retained output and exact observable effects. Merely adding an unused parameter is not repair.

Unknown alternate API shapes go to blinded manual adjudication under frozen acceptance obligations. Unsupported but plausible shape remains unassessed, never failed or repaired by name/string heuristic.

Self-check original defect, reference repair, clean control, all-facts-deletion mutant, each added-fact-deletion mutant, wrongly narrowed valid-domain mutant, and unused-dependency or hardcoded-return mutant.
Freeze automated and manual source/support digests and judgments before joining candidate identity.
existingOraclePitfalls: Existing score-abide-rule-coverage.mjs imports old fixed case IDs and constructs narrow witnesses; new required fields cause all old witnesses to fail independently of repair.
Existing publicShape only guards original known fields. It can miss deletion of newly added independent facts or unknown renamed/nested representations.
Existing compiler probes assume particular exports, names and grouping paths; nested large records need explicit schema mapping or manual review, not suffix matching.
Existing callable rename test demands displayLabel parameter; a function without that artificial parameter requires an independent task-success test.
Existing r8/r9 manual labels do not provide runtime validity by themselves; concrete clock/audit/resource probes are required for new function examples.
Do not modify oracle after seeing losing outputs. Unknown representations can be manually evaluated only under the already frozen semantic contract.

metrics.attribution: Report artifact repairs independently from receipt-linked repairs; spontaneous baseline/Abide repair without confirmed finding is not proof of reviewer causation.
metrics.causality: Matched layout contrasts strengthen evidence about available context; full product comparison still combines graph/diff input, instructions and native hook behavior, so it is not an isolated context-only intervention.
metrics.statistics: With two detection repetitions and one native repetition per case report counts, case-level contrasts and disagreements; do not claim significance, general superiority or population estimates.

stopCriteria: Global336physical Jev attempts or per-cell cap reached: stop further requests, retain budget-stopped cells, no retry.
Five-minute native session timeout: retain timed-out artifact and transport status; continue remaining frozen cells if budget permits.
Credential or infrastructure failure affecting comparison symmetry: stop matrix and diagnose without favorable replacement; any amended run is a separately declared scope.
Unexpected product source/hash changes: stop before more measured calls.
Complete only after all declared cells have outcome records, independent scores, physical-attempt reconciliation and selected offline gates. No GitHub CI waiting gate.

candidateClassifications.component: Anonymous semantic scoring and bounded capture

evidenceModel.rule: Store class and verification separately; source inclusion is not runtime detection.
